capabilities: Display a calendar with heatmap, dots, or plain date navigation
Open or create daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly notes from the calendar
Detect note dates from frontmatter fields or filename date formats
Show todo completion indicators per date
Track note count or word count per day with configurable statistics
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; available in English, Simplified Chinese, and Brazilian Portuguese.
intentEvidence: I love obsidian-calendar-plugin, but the last update was 4 years ago, and I want some new features.
motivation: The author liked obsidian-calendar-plugin but it had not been updated in four years and wanted new features.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in visual calendar for navigating, creating, and seeing activity across periodic notes.

relations.evidence: I love obsidian-calendar-plugin, but the last update was 4 years ago

summary: Sidebar calendar view that tracks daily note activity with heatmaps or dots and opens or creates daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly notes.
